**Claude kya karta hai:**
- Pehle naye **`ref`** command se reference ko shot-by-shot todta hai:
  - frame ka shape (16:9 / 9:16)
  - har shot kab shuru hua aur kitna lamba hai
  - har cut kaisa hai: seedha cut, white flash, dip to black, whip ya dissolve
  - kitni movement hai, beat par kitne cuts hain, rang kaisa hai
- Phir ek sheet dekhta hai jisme har shot ka ek frame hota hai, taaki samjhe ki kaun sa shot wide hai, kaun close-up, kahan text hai aur look kaisa hai.
- Phir aapki footage se wahi kram, wahi shot lengths aur cut rhythm (gaane ki beat par), wahi transitions, text style aur look banata hai.
- Aakhir mein 2-4 line mein batata hai ki kitna milta-julta bana aur kya alag hai.

**Suraksha:** reference file project ke Media mein nahi jaati (alag `cache\claude\refs` folder mein rehti hai), isliye reference ka koi shot kabhi aapke edit mein nahi aayega. Galat lage to **Ctrl+Z** ya **↶ AI undo**.

**Kya jaancha:**
- Ek test reference banaya jisme 1.50s aur 3.50s par cut the. `ref` command ne dono cut bilkul sahi pakde.
- Browser mein 📎 se file attach ki: upload hui, alag folder mein save hui, Media mein nahi gayi, aur Claude ko sahi message bana.

**🤖** I'm waiting for the exports to finish. As soon as they do, I'll restart and check that "Save to" and the rest are working. Meanwhile, the answers to your questions:

**"Will all this show up on every PC?" Yes:**
- Everything comes from this PC (the editor), so other PCs get it after a **Ctrl+F5** in the browser.
- **Shortcuts:** every PC gets the Premiere Pro default keys. If someone changes keys in the ⌨ window, that stays in their own browser only, so each person can keep their own keys.
- **Save to (export folder):** only shows for **Owner** logins (this PC, or a login with the Owner role). Editors/viewers can't save files to just any folder on this PC; that's for safety.

**Where the Export "Browse" option is:**
- **Deliver page** → right under **File name** at the top: **📁 Save to [ ] 📁 Browse**
- And in the **Export timeline** section at the bottom (above the "Export timeline (XML)" button) the same **📁 Save to / Browse**

**🤖** Saara kaam ho gaya hai. Bas server ka restart aur Desktop ka khaali folder hatana baaki hai, dono ke liye niche dekho.

**1. Kya Claude Opus 5.5 se edit kar raha tha? Nahi.** Is computer ki Claude settings mein default model `sonnet` set hai, isliye editor ka Claude ab tak **Sonnet 5.5** par chal raha tha. Editor ke sessions mein yahi `claude-sonnet-5-5` dikh raha hai.
- Ab editor Claude ko khud `--model opus` deta hai, toh restart ke baad yeh **Opus 5.5** par chalega.
- Assistant ke progress bar par ab model ka naam bhi dikhega, jaise "Opus 5.5 · 3 min", toh aage khud check kar sakte ho.
- Opus, Sonnet se dheema aur mehenga hai. Wapas Sonnet chahiye ho toh editor ki config mein `"claudeModel": "sonnet"` likh do.

**2. Purani chats ab mitengi nahi.** Assistant mein **🗂 Chats** list aa gayi hai, jisme har project ki aakhri 10 chats save rehti hain (tumne kam se kam 6 kaha tha). Page reload karne ya New chat dabane par bhi purani chats bachi rehti hain. Purani chat kholo toh Claude bhi wahi baatcheet aage chalata hai. Yeh chats har browser mein alag save hoti hain, toh har user ko apni chats dikhengi.

**3. 20 log ek saath kaam karein toh atkega?** Pehle atak sakta tha. Ek saath kitne agent chalein iski koi seema nahi thi, aur 20 edits ek saath whisper `large-v3` ko 8 GB wale GPU par chadha dete.
- **Ab:** ek saath zyada se zyada **2 agent edits** aur **4 Claude chats** chalenge. Baaki line mein wait karenge aur unhe "Waiting in line (2 ahead)" dikhega. Kisi ko error nahi aayega. Line mein wait karti Claude chat ko Stop bhi kiya ja sakta hai.
- Pehle jab bhi koi agent chal raha hota tha, nayi footage ke preview (proxies) poori tarah ruk jaate the. Bahut log hon toh woh kabhi bante hi nahi. Ab agent chalte waqt bhi 1 proxy banti rehti hai.
- Yeh limits `VEDIT_MAX_AGENTS` / `VEDIT_MAX_CLAUDE` se badli ja sakti hain. 2 aur 4 maine andaaze se rakhe hain, 20 logon ke saath asli load test nahi kiya.
- **Bhaari files:** maine 4K footage par proxies CPU aur GPU (NVENC) dono se banakar dekhi. GPU tez nahi nikla (3 proxies: CPU 12.7 s, GPU 14 s), kyunki asli rukaawat Z: drive se file padhne mein hai. Isliye proxy ka encoder nahi badla. Footage tez drive par ho toh yeh hissa sabse zyada tez hoga.

**4. Folder:** editor pehle se hi `D:\Video Editor Agent` mein hai, aur Desktop ka shortcut bhi wahi kholta hai. Desktop wale folder mein sirf ek khaali file thi. Woh file maine delete kar di. Khaali folder abhi isliye nahi hata kyunki yeh session usi mein khula hai. Iske baad yeh session D: par chala jaayega, phir woh folder seedha delete kar sakte ho. Memory notes bhi D: wale project mein copy kar diye hain.

**Ab tumhe karna hai:** server ki file badli hai, isliye editor ek baar restart karna padega. Abhi koi job nahi chal raha (maine check kiya). Editor ki khuli console window band karo aur Desktop ke **Video Editor Agent** shortcut se dobara chalao. Phir browser mein **F5** dabao.

Yeh badlaav, aur pichhli baar ke slider aur shortcuts wale badlaav, abhi commit nahi kiye hain. Bolo toh sab commit karke push kar doon.

**🤖** Loading wali dikkat theek kar di hai, aur logo/text hatane ke liye mask bhi jod diya hai. Sab commit karke push kar diya: [`96bd065`](https://github.com/Jaspreetnov-11/EditorAgent/commit/96bd065). Inme se kai cheezein tabhi chalengi jab editor ek baar restart hoga (neeche likha hai).

**1. Loading mein itna samay kyun lag raha tha**
- Media list maangne par server project ki saari 1267 files ek-ek karke check karta tha ki woh Z: aur L: network drives par maujood hain ya nahi. Is dauraan **poora server ruka rehta tha**, sirf tumhare liye nahi, saare users ke liye. Is computer par hi media list 12 second mein aa rahi thi.
- Ab yeh jaanch background mein, kai files ek saath hoti hai, aur list turant chali jaati hai. Mere test mein jaanch 2 second se ghat kar 0.15 second ki ho gayi, aur server bas 7ms ke liye ruka.
- 1.3 MB ki media list ab compress hokar jaati hai, lagbhag 10 guna chhoti. editor.limelightcorp.in par isse sabse zyada fark padega.
- Yeh fix restart ke baad hi lagega. Restart ke baad media list kitni der mein aati hai, yeh maine napa nahi hai.

**2. Logo aur text hatana (Mask)**
- Clip select karo → Effect Controls → **▭ Hide logo / text (mask)** → Program monitor par logo ya text ke upar dabba kheencho.
- Har dabbe ke liye chuno: **Remove** (aas-paas ki tasveer se bhar dena), Blur, Pixelate ya Black. Ek clip par jitne chaho utne dabbe laga sakte ho.
- Preview mein Remove sirf dhundhla dikhta hai. Asli "hatana" Accurate preview aur render mein dikhega.
- Test: दंतेवाड़ा text par dabba kheench kar dekha. Dabba bana aur preview mein dhundhla dikha. Render mein lagne wala filter maine sirf ffmpeg mein alag se chala kar jaancha hai. Is project ka asli render maine nahi chalaya, toh pehli baar Accurate preview dabakar zaroor dekhna.
- Ek seema hai: dabba poore shot mein ek hi jagah rehta hai. Drone shot mein logo screen par chipka hota hai, isliye yahan kaam karega. Lekin jo text camera ke saath hilta ho, uske liye yeh kaafi nahi.

**3. Generative fill (AI)**
Yeh abhi nahi jodaa. "Remove" aas-paas ke pixels se khaali jagah bharta hai, jo chhote logo ke liye theek hai. Bade text ke liye asli AI generative fill ke liye ek AI model (jaise LaMa / ProPainter) download aur install karna padega, kuch sau MB ka. Har frame bharne mein GPU par samay bhi lagega. Bolo toh install karke jod doon.

**4. Copy a reference ab saare editors ke liye**
- Team ke editors bhi ab Claude chala sakte hain: reference upload karke edit banwana aur Assistant, dono. Pehle sirf owner kar sakta tha.
- Suraksha ke liye editors ka Claude sirf `Projects` aur `engine` folder padh sakta hai, is computer ki baaki files nahi. Tumhare liye sab pehle jaisa hai.
- Dhyaan rahe: editors ka Claude bhi tumhare hi Claude plan ki limit khaayega.

**5. Tool column ke icons:** buttons zyada hone par icons dab kar ek-doosre par chadh jaate the. Ab har button poore size ka rehta hai aur jagah kam pade toh column scroll ho jaata hai.

Project ke saare 68 tests pass hue.

**Restart:** abhi server par koi job nahi chal raha. Media list wala fix aur editors ke liye Claude, dono server ke badlaav hain, isliye editor ki console window band karke Desktop ke **Video Editor Agent** shortcut se dobara chalao. Baaki cheezein (mask, tool column) ke liye browser mein **F5** kaafi hai.

**1. Sab PCs ko sab ijaazat, tracking sirf owner ke paas**
- Team ke editors ab Claude chala sakte hain, reference upload karke edit banwa sakte hain, settings badal sakte hain, kahin bhi export save kar sakte hain, aur projects delete kar sakte hain.
- Sirf owner ke paas rahega: team ke users aur passwords, kaun kab login hua (Sessions tracking), aur team settings.

**2. Preview kaala hona**
- Is computer par 12 second ke playback mein ek baar bhi kaala nahi aaya. Dikkat internet (editor.limelightcorp.in) wale raaste ki thi: wahan har cut par 21 Mbps ki 4 GB wali asli file stream hoti thi.
- Ab jab koi internet se project kholta hai, us project ki bhaari files ki halki 540p copy apne aap banti hai, timeline wali clips pehle. Use wahi halki copy jaati hai. Is computer par asli file hi chalti rahegi.
- Agla shot load hote waqt ab screen kaali hone ke bajaye pichhla frame dikhta rahega.
- Internet par yeh test nahi kar paaya. Restart ke baad halki copies banne mein thoda samay lagega, uske baad dekh kar batana.

**3. ✨ AI fill (content-aware)**
- Tumne ProPainter chuna tha, lekin uska license commercial kaam ki ijaazat nahi deta. Isliye tumhari haan ke baad LaMa lagaya, jo commercial kaam mein free hai. Model (196 MB) `tools/models` mein hai aur git mein nahi gaya.
- Kaise use karein: clip select karo → Effect Controls → **▭ Hide logo / text** se dabba kheencho → **✨ AI fill the boxes** dabao. Ek nayi "filled" copy banti hai aur timeline par clip ki jagah lag jaati hai. **↶ Original shot** se wapas aa jaata hai.
- Test: tumhari Dantewada wali clip par "दंतेवाड़ा" text aur "Chhattisgarh 360" logo dono saaf hat gaye, aur unki jagah asli jaisa sheher bhar gaya.
- Samay: 2.7 second ki clip mein lagbhag 25 second lage. Ek baar mein ek hi AI fill chalta hai.
- Dabba text ko poora dhakna chahiye. Pehle test mein dabba thoda chhota tha, toh laal patti ka kinara bacha raha.

**4. Transition dono clips ke beech:** ab dabba theek cut ke upar baithta hai, aadha pichhli clip par aur aadha agli par, bow-tie aur naam ke saath. Effect wali clips par *fx* dikhta hai.

**5. Clips ke beech jagah:** har clip ab alag dabba hai, beech mein gap hai, aur upar shot ki tasveerein (filmstrip) dikhti hain.

Abhi baaki hai: **Keyframes** aur **Motion & opacity** ko Premiere jaisa simple banana. Har property ki ek line ho, saath mein value aur keyframe ke ◀◆▶ buttons, aur bade sliders na hon. Bolo toh ab woh shuru karun.

**🤖** Transition, clip ka look, Motion panel, slow-mo playback aur AI Enhance ho gaye hain. Sab commit karke push kar diya: [`8b6aa2d`](https://github.com/Jaspreetnov-11/EditorAgent/commit/8b6aa2d). Doosre PC wala Claude bhi chal pada hai: abhi ek editor ke project "intro sirpur" par Claude **Opus 5.5** se kaam kar raha hai.

**1. Transition ab clip ko nahi chhedta**
- Transition lagane, hatane ya uski lambai badalne par cut apni jagah rehta hai aur koi clip nahi hilti. Dono clips cut ke aage-peeche ke extra frames deti hain.
- Test: transition lagane, lambai badalne aur hatane par timeline ki kul lambai aur baad ki clips bilkul wahi rahin. Hatane par clips ke in/out pehle jaise ho gaye.
- **Dono kinare alag-alag:** baayan kinara cut se pehle ka hissa badalta hai, daayan cut ke baad ka. Kinare par laal bracket cursor aata hai.
- Purana transition (pehle ka bana hua) dobara chhedoge toh story mein jo lambai pehle kat gayi thi woh wapas aa sakti hai. Tumhare project mein yeh 0.5 second tha. Clip kabhi nahi kategi.

**2. Timeline Premiere jaisi:** har clip par upar patli rangeen patti mein naam aur *fx*, neeche tasveer, clips ke beech patli line, aur chaukor kone. CC/M jaise badge hata kar tooltip mein daal diye. Clip ke kinaron par laal `[` `]` trim cursor aata hai aur pakadne ki jagah chaudi hai.

**3. Motion (Effect Controls):** "Motion & opacity" aur "Keyframes" milkar ab ek **Motion** section hain. Har property ki ek line hai: ⏱ (keyframe chalu/band), naam, neeli value (mouse se kheencho ya click karke type karo), ◂◆▸, aur usi line mein keyframes. Value kheenchna aur ⏱ dono test kiye.

**4. Slow-mo / speed ramp ka atakna:** player pehle har chhoti gadbad par video ko kooda deta tha, isliye jhatke lagte the. Ab woh video thodi tez ya dheemi chala kar dheere se sahi jagah laata hai. Is computer par slow-mo playback chala kar yeh fix nahi jaancha. Tum dekh kar batana ki ab smooth hai ya nahi.

**5. ✨ AI Enhance (Topaz jaisa):** Effect Controls → AI picture tools mein hai.
- Options: Fast ya Most detail, Same / 1080p / 4K, aur noise saaf karna ya grain rakhna.
- Real-ESRGAN models (BSD-3, commercial kaam mein free) `tools/models` mein hain.
- Pehli koshish mein 1080p tasveer plastic jaisi chikni ho gayi thi. Sudhaar ke baad detail bachi rehti hai.
- 2 second ki 1080p clip ko 55 second lage. Most detail model aur dheema hai.
- Yeh button server restart ke baad hi chalega.

**Restart:** abhi editor ka Claude job chal raha hai, isliye maine server restart nahi kiya. Woh job khatam hote hi editor ki window band karke shortcut se dobara chalao. Baaki sab (timeline, Motion, transition) ke liye browser mein **F5** kaafi hai.

**Abhi baaki:** Pen tool aur Premiere ke Ripple Edit (B), Rolling Edit (N), Rate Stretch (R) aur Remix tools. Bolo toh agla kaam yahi karun.

**1. Trim**
- **Daayen se chhota karo:** clip ke baad khaali jagah bachti hai, agli clip apni jagah rehti hai.
- **Baayen se chhota karo:** sirf baayan kinara hilta hai aur pehle khaali jagah banti hai. Test mein clip ka shuru 10.47 se 10.97 par gaya, aakhiri hissa 12.68 par hi raha.
- **Bada karna:** sirf bagal ki khaali jagah tak, padosi clip ke upar nahi.
- **Ctrl dabakar** ya **Ripple tool (B)** se: purana tareeka, jisme story khisakti hai.
- Baayen kinare par ek chhupa hua "+" button tha, jo trim ke bajaye transition laga deta tha. "Left se kar raha toh right se ho raha" ki ek wajah yeh bhi thi. Woh button hata diya. Transition Effects panel, Ctrl+D aur right-click se lagta hai.

**2. Transition ko kheench kar doosre cut par:** dabbe ko pakdo aur kisi bhi cut par chhod do, woh wahin chala jaayega. Sirf click karoge toh uski settings khulengi. Is drag ko maine browser mein test nahi kiya.

**3. Default tracks:** ab har timeline, purani bhi, **V1, V2, V3 + A1, A2** dikhati hai. Khaali A3 tab tak chhupa rehta hai jab tak sound effects na lagein.

**4. Naye tools (timeline ke left column mein):**
- **Ripple Edit (B):** kinara kheencho toh baad ki story khisakti hai.
- **Rolling Edit (N):** cut ko aage-peeche karo, kul lambai wahi rehti hai. Test mein cut 12.68 se 13.18 par gaya aur kuch aur nahi hila.
- **Rate Stretch (R):** kinara kheencho toh speed badal kar clip nayi lambai mein fit ho jaati hai. Test mein speed 129% hui. Jaanch mein ek baat dikhi: is project mein iske baad ki kuch clips 0.01 second (ek frame se kam) khisak gayin. Wajah pakki nahi mili. Yeh rounding ho sakti hai ya mere pichhle test ka asar, isliye ise theek nahi kiya.
- **Pen (P):** clip par opacity (video) ya volume (audio) ki peeli line dikhti hai. Click karo toh keyframe banta hai, jitna upar utni zyada value.
- **Remix:** music clip ka kinara kheencho, toh gaana us lambai mein uske sabse achhe hisse se dobara kat jaata hai. Ise maine test nahi kiya, kyunki iske liye server se asli request chahiye thi.

**Restart:** AI Enhance button ke liye server restart zaroori hai. Abhi ek editor ka Claude ("intro sirpur") chal raha hai, isliye maine ek watcher lagaya hai. Jaise hi koi job ya render nahi chalega, woh editor ko tumhari bat file se apne aap restart kar dega (agle 1 ghante tak). Baaki sab cheezon ke liye browser mein **F5** kaafi hai.

### 🧑 2026-10-22 00:09

\yeh bata agar mein isko windows ke liye exe software jaisa bana du toh bhi yeh same kaam karegi jaise abhi live 20 25 log ek sath edit kar paare hai aur ekdum same chiz same chale bs browser mein open na hoke application jaise open ho aisa possible hai ???

**🤖** Haan, bilkul possible hai, aur live editing bhi waisi hi chalegi. Bas ek baat samajhni zaroori hai ki asli kaam kahan hota hai.

**Abhi kaise chalta hai:**
- Asli editor ek hi jagah chalta hai: aapke main PC ka server (`node server.mjs`). Footage, project, live editing (20-25 log ek saath), render aur Claude, sab wahin hai.
- Baaki PCs pe browser sirf ek "khidki" hai, jo us server se judti hai.

Isliye exe banane ke do tareeke hain, aur dono ka nateeja bahut alag hai:

**1. Exe sirf khidki ho (yahi sahi hai)** ✅
- Ek chhota sa `Limelight Editor.exe` banta hai, jo apni window mein https://editor.limelightcorp.in kholta hai. Isme browser ka address bar ya tabs nahi hote.
- Andar Edge wala hi engine (WebView2) hota hai, toh video playback, upload, timeline sab bilkul same chalega.
- Live editing 100% same rahegi, kyunki sab log usi ek server se jude hain.
- Editor mein jo bhi naya feature aayega, woh har PC pe apne aap dikhega. Exe dobara install nahi karna padega, kyunki screen server se aati hai.
- Ise **Tauri** se banayenge, jisse exe sirf ~5-10 MB ka hoga. Electron se ~100 MB ka banta.

**2. Har PC ke exe mein poora editor (yeh mat karna)** ❌
- Phir har PC ka apna alag server, alag projects aur alag footage hoga.
- Live ek saath editing khatam ho jayegi, aur har PC pe FFmpeg, Python aur Claude alag se lagane padenge.

**Ek kaam ki baat:** jo Install button maine abhi lagaya hai, woh pehle tareeke ka lagbhag 90% hai. Usse bhi editor apni alag window mein khulta hai aur Desktop/Start menu mein icon lagta hai. Fark sirf itna hai ki woh Chrome/Edge ke andar se install hota hai, `.exe` file nahi hoti.

**Asli `.exe` se kya milega:**
- Ek setup file jo pen drive ya WhatsApp se har PC pe bhej ke install kar sakte ho.
- Apna naam aur icon, aur Windows ke "Apps" mein dikhega.

**Ek dikkat:** bina code-signing certificate ke Windows pehli baar "Windows protected your PC" ki warning dikhayega. User ko "More info › Run anyway" dabana padega. Certificate saalana paid aata hai, lagbhag ₹15-25 hazaar. Office ke andar use ke liye warning chala sakte ho.

**Main PC ke liye bonus:** server ko bhi ek tray app bana sakte hain. Phir woh kaali cmd window nahi rahegi, Windows start hote hi editor apne aap chalu ho jayega, aur ghadi ke paas Limelight ka icon dikhega.

Bolo toh pehle tareeke wala Tauri exe aur setup file bana doon. Saath mein main PC ke server ko tray app bhi bana sakta hoon.

- Pehle wala chhota preview kitni der mein banta tha, woh maine naapa nahi. Isliye kitna dheere hua, uski exact tulna nahi hai.
- Aapki 7:48 wali film ka pehla preview kaafi minute le sakta hai. Uske baad chhote badlav pe jaldi banega.

**1. Masking (Premiere jaisi)**
- Har video effect ke neeche ab **Mask** row hai: ◯ Ellipse ya ▭ Rectangle.
  - Mask lagao toh effect sirf uske andar lagta hai, jaise sirf chehre pe blur.
  - "Inverted" pe tick karo toh effect bahar lagta hai.
- Clip ke liye naya section hai: **◐ Opacity mask**. Clip sirf mask ke andar dikhta hai.
  - V1 pe baaki hissa kaala ho jata hai.
  - V2 ya upar wale tracks pe baaki hisse mein neeche wala shot dikhta hai.
- Mask lagate hi Program monitor pe uski shape handles ke saath aa jaati hai. Andar se kheencho toh hilti hai, kinaron se kheencho toh size badalta hai. Kaam ho jaye toh **Esc** dabao.
- Har mask mein Feather, Expansion, Mask opacity aur Inverted ke controls hain.
- Mask clip ke saath chalta hai: Motion se clip hilao ya zoom karo toh mask bhi saath jata hai.

Maine test video pe Accurate preview mein frames nikaal ke dekhe. Masked blur, V1 opacity mask aur V2 opacity mask, teeno sahi jagah aaye.

Do cheezein abhi nahi ho saktin:
- Mask keyframe ke saath animate nahi hota.
- Green screen aur Opacity mask ek hi clip pe saath mein theek nahi chalte.

**2. Effect Controls**
- Effects panel se koi effect lagao (double-click ya drag) toh Effect Controls apne aap khulta hai aur us effect ka section dikhata hai. Yeh video effect, cut effect, speed ramp, transition aur audio effect sab pe hota hai.
- Cut effect ka ab apna alag **⚡ Cut effect** section hai.
- Mask lagane ya effect badalne pe Effect Controls ka scroll ab upar nahi bhaagta.

**3. Menu bar**
Upar File, Edit, Clip, Sequence, Markers, Graphics and Titles, View, Window aur Help aa gaye hain. Har item editor ka koi maujooda kaam chalata hai, aur saath mein uski shortcut key dikhti hai. Maine Edit menu khol ke dekha, aur Logo aur Backups wali windows bhi khul rahi hain.

**Aapke beech ke messages**
- **Effect Controls se hataya:** Text, Color (quick), Audio, Transition in, Fade to black, Logo / watermark, Subtitles aur Backups. Kuch cheezein kahin aur chali gayi hain taaki feature gayab na ho:
  - Logo / watermark aur Backups ab **File** menu mein hain.
  - Subtitles Deliver page pe hain, aur colour Color page pe.
  - Transition badalna ho toh timeline pe transition pe click karo.
  - Title clip ka text aur audio clip ka volume abhi bhi Effect Controls mein hain. Inke bina title ke shabd aur audio clip ka volume badalne ki koi jagah nahi bachti.
  - **Fade to black ab kahin bhi set nahi hota.** Purane projects mein jo fade lage hain woh render mein chalte rahenge.
- **"Project default" dropdown** (Framing) Motion se hata ke Clip section mein daal diya. Motion mein keyframe lane ab zyada chaudi aur oonchi hai.
- **Naam wala chip** ("Jaspreet · owner") ab ek hi line mein rahta hai. Isko maine screen pe dekh ke check nahi kiya.

**Gyroflow (FPV gyro stabilization)**

Ise jodne ke liye official Gyroflow (github.com/gyroflow/gyroflow, free, Windows wala, lagbhag 100-150 MB) editor ke `tools` folder mein download karna padega. Phir ek "Gyroflow stabilize" effect bana dunga jo GoPro, DJI, Insta360 ki gyro info ya FPV (Betaflight) blackbox log se shot stabilize karega. Download kar doon?

**Download:** official Gyroflow v1.6.3 (free, github.com/gyroflow/gyroflow). Isse `tools/gyroflow` folder mein ~129 MB jagah lagi. Download ki zip file delete kar di.

**Kaise use karna hai:**
1. Timeline pe shaky video clip select karo.
2. Effect Controls mein **🛸 Gyroflow (gyro stabilize)** section kholo. Yahi **Clip › Stabilize with Gyroflow…** menu se bhi khulta hai.
3. Teen settings set karo:
   - **Smoothness:** kitna smooth chahiye.
   - **Horizon lock:** FPV mein horizon seedha rakhta hai.
   - **Extra zoom:** kinare chhupane ke liye thoda zoom.
4. **🛸 Stabilize with Gyroflow** dabao. Button pe progress dikhegi.
5. Stabilized nayi file Media ke **Gyroflow** bin mein aati hai aur clip pe apne aap lag jaati hai. In/Out wahi rehte hain.
6. Pasand na aaye toh **↩ Back to the original** dabao, purani file wapas aa jayegi. Settings badal ke dobara bhi chala sakte ho.

**Gyro data kahan se aata hai:**
- GoPro, DJI, Insta360, Sony ki files mein gyro data andar hi hota hai.
- **FPV drone** ke liye flight log chahiye (Betaflight `.bbl` / `.bfl` / `.csv`). Use video ke paas usi naam se rakh do, editor khud dhoondh lega. Ya uska path "Flight log" box mein paste kar do.
- Video mein gyro data na ho toh saaf message aata hai ki log do, ya Warp Stabilizer use karo.

**Kya test kiya:**
- Bina gyro wali video pe sahi error aaya.
- Ek nakli gyro log ke saath poora raasta chala: log apne aap mila, Gyroflow ne picture stabilize ki, aur nayi file Media mein ready ho gayi.
- Aapke projects mein asli GoPro, DJI ya FPV footage nahi mili, isliye asli flight pe test nahi kiya. Pehli asli FPV ya GoPro clip pe ek baar check kar lena.

Kuch bhi commit nahi kiya hai.

**Haal:**
- **Editor ab tez khulta hai:** editor ki files 0.2 second mein aa rahi hain, jabki yogeshwar ka bada footage scan chal raha hai. Woh fix server ke 19:33/19:43 wale restart se lag chuka hai, toh kaala screen wali dikkat ab nahi aani chahiye.
- **Restart nahi hua:** watcher 3 ghante ruka, lekin is poore waqt koi na koi kaam chalta raha, isliye usne kisi ka kaam nahi toda. File-workers 4 se 32 wala dusra fix agle tray restart pe lagega.

**Error log ne aaj 3 asli bug pakde, teeno theek:**
1. **Server:** NAS (Z:) pe project mein file upload hote waqt rename fail hua tha. Ab woh upload saaf error deta hai, server pe asar nahi padta.
2. **Home pe jaate waqt crash:** project band hote hi playhead hila toh timeline atak jaati thi. Ab nahi.
3. **Media panel ka `lastClick`:** yeh doosre session ne pehle hi theek kar diya tha.

Browser ke aam, bekaar ke messages (video `play()` interrupted, ResizeObserver) ab log mein nahi aayenge, taaki sirf asli problems dikhein.

**Dhyan dene wali baat:** is folder mein **ek aur Claude session** kaam kar raha hai. Usne ~27 files badli hain: naya "people" feature, smart search, server mein ~445 lines aur Home page. Uska kaam abhi commit nahi hua hai, aur server jab bhi restart hota hai toh uska adhoora code bhi live ho jaata hai. 19:33 aur 19:43 ke restart shayad usi session ne kiye the. Maine uski files nahi chhuin, sirf apni teen chhoti jagah badli jo uske kaam se alag hain.

Mere ye fix (upload, layout, error filter, memory files, tray workers) abhi commit nahi kiye hain, kyunki unhi files mein doosre session ka adhoora kaam bhi hai. Agar main ab commit karun toh uska adhoora kaam bhi saath chala jayega. Kya karun:
1. Sirf apne fix alag se commit karun, ya
2. Doosre session ke khatam hone ka intezaar karun, phir sab ek saath?

**🤖** Aapke teeno sawaal:

**1. Preview kaala kyun hai**
- Program monitor ke liye video NAS (`L:\`) se seedhe chalti hai, kyunki is project ki clips ki chhoti preview copy nahi bani.
- NAS se file seedhe padhne pe 20 MB 0.8 second mein aata hai. Lekin editor server ke through 4 MB mein 30–60 second lag rahe hain. Clip 70 Mbps ki hai, isliye monitor ko video mil hi nahi pa rahi.
- **Wajah:** Node ke paas file padhne ke sirf 4 "workers" hain, aur abhi saare Smart scan aur 700 files ki NAS reading mein phanse hain. Chat 09 ne inhe 4 se 32 karne ka fix 18:25 pe likha tha, par server 18:06 se chal raha hai, isliye **woh fix live hi nahi hua**.
- Maine yeh setting [server.mjs](server.mjs) ke andar bhi daal di hai, taaki server kaise bhi start ho, yeh lage. Chhote test mein yeh kaam karta dikha.
- Ise lagaane ke liye server restart chahiye. Abhi nahi kiya, kyunki 7 kaam chal rahe hain (3 Assistant) aur aapne Assistant ko na todne ko kaha tha. Restart kab karna hai, neeche box mein chun lijiye.
- **Tab tak ka jugaad:** is project ka Smart scan khatam hone pe ya rokne pe preview tez ho jaana chahiye.

**2. Comp aur Fusion ab hamesha V3 ya usse upar**
- Chaaron jagah ab ek hi niyam hai: Motion comp, clip se comp, Color Matte, aur Fusion.
- Clip V3 pe jaati hai. Agar V3 pe us samay koi aur clip ho, toh uske upar wale track pe. Saare track bhare hon toh naya track banta hai. Jis clip se comp ya Fusion bana, woh hamesha usse upar jaata hai.
- Comp wala purana code track galat disha mein dhoondhta tha, woh bhi theek ho gaya ([model.js](public/js/model.js), [motionpage.js](public/js/motionpage.js), [fusionpage.js](public/js/fusionpage.js)).
- Aapke project mein jo comp V2 pe tha, woh Assistant ke dobara edit banane se hat chuka hai. Abhi wahan sirf V1 hai, isliye hilaane ko kuch nahi bacha.

**3. Ctrl+scroll ab upar-neeche**
- Track headers pe Ctrl+scroll ko editor pakadta hi nahi tha, isliye browser ka page-zoom chal jaata tha. Aapki screenshot mein V5…A2 isi wajah se ek doosre pe chadh gaye the.
- Ab Premiere jaisa hai:
  - Saada scroll: aage-peeche
  - **Ctrl+scroll: upar-neeche** (clips aur headers dono jagah)
  - Alt+scroll: zoom
- Browser mein asli wheel events bhej ke jaancha. Ctrl+scroll ne tracks 100px neeche kiye, aur na timeline ka zoom badla na browser ka.

Point 2 aur 3 ke liye restart nahi chahiye: editor tab mein **F5** dabaiye. Agar headers abhi bhi chipke dikhein toh **Ctrl+0** dabaiye, browser ka zoom wapas 100% ho jaayega. 64 tests pass hain. Kuch commit nahi kiya. Phase 20 ka kaam [apne alag session](#local_190c8544-68c9-40f5-b585-54b26306d7fb) mein chal raha hai.

**🤖** Is repo se editor mein jodne layak kuch nahi mila. Isme koi code hai hi nahi.

**Repo mein kya hai:** sirf ek 2 KB ka README. Woh kehta hai "Releases" se Premiere Pro ka archive download karo aur saath ke **keygen** se saare features unlock karo. Yeh pirated software ka chaara hai, aur aise repos aksar malware (password ya crypto churaane wale programs) failaane ke kaam aate hain. Maine release se kuch download nahi kiya, sirf README padha, aur clone ki hui copy bhi mita di. Aap bhi ise mat chalaiye, aur doosre PCs pe bhi kisi ko na chalaane dein.

**Isme likhe "features" editor mein pehle se hain:** multi-track editing, real-time preview, effects aur transitions, Color page pe grading, aur Deliver page pe kai format/resolution mein export. Isliye overlap ka sawaal bhi nahi uthta.

Agar Premiere ka koi asli kaam editor mein chahiye, jaise koi tool, shortcut ya panel jo yahan nahi hai, toh neeche box se bataiye. Main hamare editor ko Premiere ke asli features se milaake kami ki list bhi bana sakta hoon, phir aap chun lena.

**Pehle galat kyun tha:** har audio file ki sirf ek 1600px ki tasveer banti thi, jo clip ki poori lambai pe kheench di jaati thi. 2 minute ki VO mein ek pixel ~0.1 second ka hota tha. Isliye zoom karne pe "◆--◆" jaise tukde dikhte the jo awaaz se mel nahi khaate the.

**Ab kaise banta hai:**
- Server har audio file se har 10 millisecond ki asli awaaz ki oonchaai (peak) nikalta hai. Yeh ek baar banta hai aur save rehta hai. 2 minute ki VO ke liye ~13 KB.
- Timeline har zoom pe in peaks se canvas pe seedha waveform banati hai, Premiere jaisa beech se upar-neeche.
- Clip ka trim, speed aur loop bhi dhyaan mein rehte hain.
- Sirf screen pe dikhne wala hissa banta hai, isliye lambi VO pe bhi timeline dheemi nahi hogi.

**Kaise jaancha:** "Sirpur 2 min" ki ek copy alag test server pe chalayi, asli projects ko haath nahi lagaya.

- Tasveer mein VO ke shabd ke tukde aur beech ki chuppi saaf dikhte hain. Music ka halka shuruaati hissa aur phir tez beat bhi.

**1. Quality kyun gir rahi thi**
- DJI ki 4K HEVC files ke liye monitor ek chhoti preview copy chala raha tha — sirf **960×540, 1.1 Mbps**. Premiere asli 4K chalata hai, isliye wahan sharp dikhta hai.
- Maine jaancha ki browser khud 4K HEVC chala sakta hai: aapki DJI file **0.75 sec mein load hui aur ek bhi frame drop nahi hua**.
- **Ab:** jo camera file browser khud chala sake (DJI, Sony, phone ki HEVC), woh monitor pe **asli file se** chalti hai, Premiere jaisi quality mein. Bonus: aisi nayi files ki preview copy bannे ka intezaar bhi nahi karna padega.
- 540p copy ab sirf do jagah: jo files browser nahi chala sakta (MXF, ProRes, 4:2:2), aur jab editor office network ke bahar se (internet link se) khula ho — kyunki 130 Mbps ki 4K file internet pe stream nahi ho paati.

**2. Warp Stabilizer jitter kyun kar raha tha**

Naap ke dekha (har frame mein 300 points track karke, 4K pixels mein):

| | Shake |
|---|---|
| Asli drone shot (DJI gimbal, pehle se steady) | 0.40 |
| Purana stabilizer, aapke settings | **1.07** — 2.5 guna zyada hilna |
| Naya stabilizer, aapke settings | **0.52** |

- **Wajah:** vid.stab aasmaan aur badal ki halki movement ko "shake" samajh raha tha. Iske upar FFmpeg ka naya camera-path tareeka bina hile shot ko bhi khiskaa raha tha. Aur shake 540p dhundhli copy pe naapa ja raha tha.
- **Sudhaar:**
  - Saade hisse (aasmaan) naap mein nahi gine jaate.
  - Camera path ke liye purana, bharosemand Gaussian tareeka.
  - "Stabilize, Crop, Auto-scale" ab poore shot ke liye ek hi fixed zoom rakhta hai (Premiere jaisa), zoom saans nahi leta.
  - Stabilized copy **asli 4K file se 1080p** mein banti hai.
- **Hilte shot pe bhi pakka kiya:** isi clip mein nakli handheld jhatke (116px) daale. Naya stabilizer unhe **0.71px** tak laaya; purana sirf 3.66px tak laata tha — yaani asli hilte shot ko bhi 5 guna behtar theek karta hai.
- Yahi settings export pe bhi lagti hain, toh monitor aur export ek jaise rahenge.

**Jaancha:** textile project ki copy pe dono DJI clips monitor pe 3840px (asli 4K) se chali. Warp wali clip analyse hui, phir 1080p stabilized copy pe switch hui. 106 tests pass hain.

5. edtool.mjs: `people`, `quotes`, maybe `find` people/text; document in engine/claude-guide.md.
6. tests/ (node tests/run.mjs) add a small test; node --check all; run full suite.

**🤖** Speed ramp wala bug theek ho gaya.

**Kya galat tha:** ramp wale clip ko cut (C / Ctrl+K) ya Q/W trim karne pe code ramp ko nazarandaaz karke seedhi speed se cut ki jagah nikaalta tha. Upar se dono tukdon ko **poora ramp dobara** mil jaata tha. Isse har tukde ki lambai badal jaati thi, aur V1 pe baad ki saari story aage-peeche khisak jaati thi.

**Ab:** cut ya trim ke baad har tukde ko poore clip ki speed-curve ka **sirf apna hissa** milta hai. Toh:
- Dono tukde bilkul usi jagah rehte hain aur unki lambai jod ke wahi rehti hai. Kuch nahi khiskta.
- Har pal pe wahi frame dikhta hai jo cut se pehle dikhta tha (1–2 frame ke andar).
- Q/W trim mein bacha hua hissa pehle jaisi speed se chalta hai, bas chhota ho jaata hai.

Har ramp preset pe (slow-mo hit, bullet time, whoosh, hero…) alag-alag jagah cut karke test kiya, sab sahi. Saare 88 tests pass hain. Ye browser wala badlav hai, toh **Ctrl+F5** se abhi lag jaayega.

**"Ramp achhe se kaam nahi kar raha"** mein agar cut ke alawa bhi kuch hai, toh ek line mein bata do kya dikhta hai: jhatke se chalna, preview aur export mein farak, ya kuch aur. Ek baat jaan-boojh ke aisi hai: ramp wale shots ki **apni aawaz band** rehti hai (render mein bhi), kyunki speed badalne se aawaz bigad jaati hai.

**Restart:** watcher abhi bhi yogeshwar ke Smart scan ke khatam hone ka intezaar kar raha hai. Khaali hote hi restart karke bataunga.

**3 — Reference jaisa edit (VO/music ke hisaab se)**
- Pehle reference se sirf har shot ki lambai aur cut-effects copy hote the; tasveerein VO ke shabdon se chuni jaati thi. Isliye edit reference jaisa kam lagta tha.
- Ab Agent reference ke har shot ka frame dekhta hai aur us slot mein **wahi dikhne wali footage** chunta hai (framing, cheez, rang), movement bhi milata hai.
- Jo clip aage ke kisi shot se sabse zyada milta hai, woh usi shot ke liye bacha ke rakha jaata hai.
- Report mein ab saaf aankda aata hai, jaise *"Looks like the reference: 8 of 10 shots"*, aur jo nahi mile unke liye kis tarah ke clips chahiye.
- Test kiya: reference laal → safed → neela tha, edit laal → (safed footage thi hi nahi) → neela bana.
- Purana "5–8%" aankda code mein kahin nahi mila. Ye naya aankda asli milaan se aata hai.

**4 — Reference edit ki layers:** V1 shots, **V2 adjustment layers (effects)**, **V3 comp/Fusion**, **V4 text**. Ek hi samay pe do clips hon toh doosra ek track upar jaata hai (V5…); kuch kisi ke neeche nahi chhupta.
- Agent ka reference edit, Claude ka `reflook`, aur **Sequence › 🧱 Arrange layers** (kabhi bhi) — teeno yahi niyam maante hain.
- Ek baat: agar kisi samay B-roll ho, toh adjustment layer uske upar jaata hai, taaki effect B-roll pe bhi lage.

**5 — Faltu footage:** Agent pehle project ki saari files tick kar deta tha. Ab:
- Media mein jo files select ki hain, sirf wahi tick hoti hain ("✔ Ticked: the 3 files selected in Media").
- Kuch select na ho toh logo/watermark wali tasveerein, Rejects/Duplicates/Brand folder, kharab clips, ek jaisi copies aur 1 sec se chhote clips chhoot jaate hain. Window mein likha hota hai kya chhoota aur kyun.
- Re-edit bhi yahi niyam maanta hai.

**6 — Saaf error messages**
- File na padhi jaaye toh wajah dikhti hai: khaali file, adhoori copy, kharab file, permission, unsupported format.
- Folder import mein BRAW, R3D, RAW photos, PSD ya Premiere project files hon toh list aati hai ki kitni hain aur kya karna hai.
- Upload, aur bina aawaz wala voice-over/music bhi saaf bataata hai kya galat hai.

**7 — Purane versions:** pehle sirf ~3 ghante ke backups bachte the. Ab **har din ki aakhri copy 60 din** tak rehti hai, Versions mein "📅 End of that day" naam se. Renders, XML, upload, thumbnails aur naye projects kabhi overwrite nahi hote, naam badal ke bachte hain.

**10 — Text select karna:** monitor pe Type tool ke text mein double-click se word, triple-click se line, aur drag, Shift+arrow, Ctrl+A sab chalte hain. Pehle double-click se text box dobara ban jaata tha aur poora text select ho jaata tha.

**11 — Media mein kai files chunna:** Ctrl/Shift pehle se chalte the, Shift ab sahi jagah se range leta hai. Naya: khaali jagah se **box kheench ke** chunna, aur **Ctrl+A / Esc**.

**Ctrl+R — Clip Speed / Duration** (Premiere jaisa): Speed %, Duration (🔗 se speed ke saath juda ya alag), Reverse speed, Maintain audio pitch, Ripple edit, aur Time interpolation (Frame sampling / Frame blending / Optical flow).
- Clip menu aur right-click mein bhi hai.
- Ctrl+R kabhi page reload nahi karta; page reload ke liye F5.
- Render pe test kiya: 50% speed + reverse + blending ke saath 16 sec ki file bani.
